symbolic.source:
operation priority(Nat): Bool
rule small(n: Nat): priority(n) = true if n > 0 and n < 4
rule special(n: Nat): priority(n) = true if n == 7
rule ordinary(n: Nat): priority(n) = false if n >= 4 and n != 7
symbolic.protocolSource:
case run(n: Nat, ok: Bool):
inputs n
result ok
pair reserve(n=n) => eligible(ok)
pair audit() => free(10 - n), reserved(n)
pair release(n=3) => ack(true)
pair audit() => free(13 - n), reserved(n - 3)
pair reserve(n=4) => eligible(false)
pair audit() => free(9 - n), reserved(n + 1)
pair release(n=n) => ack(true)
pair audit() => free(9), reserved(1)
pair reserve(n=1) => eligible(true)
pair audit() => free(8), reserved(2)
pair release(n=2) => ack(true)
pair audit() => free(10), reserved(0)
pair reserve(n=3) => eligible(true)
pair audit() => free(7), reserved(3)
pair release(n=3) => ack(true)
pair audit() => free(10), reserved(0)
